The Exchange had sought clarification from Container Corporation Of India Limited with respect to a news item captioned "Concor to invest Rs. 156 crore for 26% stake in Angul-Sukinda railway line". The Company has clarified that "CONCOR is a Navratna Company of Government of India with market capitalization at present of around Rs. 26,000 crores. It has many subsidiaries and joint ventures in the country, where it has done investment from time to time in normal course of business. The Investment in M/s Angul Sukinda Railway Limited (ASRL) as reported in the news is related to CONCOR's investment in its regular business of creating infrastructure for transportation of containers by Rail and warehousing. This investment of Rs. 156 crores for acquiring minority stake is for like any other routine expansion of infrastructure and development which CONCOR does its business. Also considering the nature and volume of its business activities, the size of investment is small and this will not have any material impact on the business and operations of the Company".
